results.title: Trust in Zelenskyy remains largely unchanged despite protests – survey
results.description: Trust in President Volodymyr Zelenskyy among Ukrainians has fallen from 58% to 55% between April and early August, according to a survey.

results.title: Prison service says Tartu recruitment drive is ahead of schedule
results.description: Recruitment is on schedule and the first officers have already been hired, the prison service has said, as it prepares for the arrival of several hundred prisoners from Sweden.

results.title: Trump Melts Down at Judge Jeanine Over Pool Sabotage Fantasy
results.description: Cheney Orr / REUTERS President Donald Trump is refusing to say whether he’s going to fire Jeanine Pirro for failing to prosecute a former Olympian accused of vandalizing a D.C. landmark. Trump, 80, handpicked Pirro, 75, to serve as U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, making the former Fox News host the capital’s top prosecutor. But her decision last week to drop charges against Olympic canoeist David Hearn infuriated the president and prompted speculation that Pirro would soon be out of a job. Read more at The Daily Beast.

results.title: SC Refuses to Interfere in SCBA Resolution on Sonam Wangchuk
results.description: Top court says it cannot intervene in the Bar Association's democratic process and asks petitioner to approach the election committee.
